These dates are a list maintained by this project and follow the month start shown in the app. Please check with your own scholar or calendar.
Choose which observances appear in the calendar.
Ramadan, the two Eids, Ashura, Shab-e-Barat and others.

A quiet notification at your reminder time. The ringing alarm is only for the first Thursday.
Check the news for the moon decision
Around the 29th of each month the app reads Google News headlines to confirm the month start. It is not an official source. Turn off to rely on forecasts only.
